archimate:ApplicationService.name: Referal Management System Service
archimate:ApplicationService.documentation:
A Referral Management System is a specialized health information platform that digitizes, tracks, and manages the end-to-end process of directing patients from primary care providers to medical specialists or secondary care facilities.
Its purpose is to optimize the patient handoff process, reduce wait times, and prevent dropped referrals by ensuring that clinical documentation, insurance pre-authorizations, and appointment statuses flow smoothly between care settings.
Example: A family doctor uses this system to instantly transmit a patient's cardiac charts to a local cardiologist, track when the specialist schedules the appointment, and automatically receive the consultation notes back into the primary care chart once the visit is complete.
